campbell.title: Campbell City Council — August 18, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered several administrative items, including selecting voting delegates for the upcoming League of California Cities annual conference and amending an agreement for city clerk services. The Council also considered accepting a grant on behalf of the Police Department, with a presentation from the police captain, and took up an item on governance related to the BART Silicon Valley project.
keyTopics: Designation of voting delegates for the 2026 League of California Cities annual conference
Resolution amending the first amended agreement for city clerk services
Grant acceptance on behalf of the Police Department, presented by the police captain
Governance matters related to the BART Silicon Valley project

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 2, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business including meeting minutes, check registers, and the Treasurer's Report, along with responses to two Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims and VTA's oversight of BART Silicon Valley Phase II. The Council also considered a contract for a Transportation Impact Fee study, forming a committee to look at alternative policing services, the future of the Saratoga Blossom Festival, and continued participation in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County.
keyTopics: Responses to Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims processing and VTA's management of BART Silicon Valley Phase II
Support for AB 1761, aimed at data transparency in utility charge calculations
An $85,000 contract with Fehr and Peers for a Transportation Impact Fee study
Forming an Ad-Hoc Committee to review alternative policing services
The future of the Saratoga Blossom Festival and continued involvement in the Cities Association of Santa Clara County

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — August 25, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered routine business including the Treasurer's Report and roof repairs at the History Museum, along with several bigger items: a public hearing on renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street, and two housing developments proposing new condominium units. The Council also reviewed construction contracts for EV chargers and the Woodland Library patio project, and discussed the future of the Joint Volunteer Awards Committee.
keyTopics: Public hearing on renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street
Vesting Tentative Map for 19 condominium units at 349 First Street
Vesting Tentative Map for 33 condominium units at Sherwood and Acacia Avenues
Contract award for Maintenance Yard EV Chargers project and History Museum roof replacement
Draft responses to Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury reports on pothole claims and BART Silicon Valley Phase II oversight

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 1, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed and approved routine meeting minutes from several August 2026 sessions. The council also considered vacating a public service easement on Cerro Vista, establishing new preferential and time-limited parking rules, and authorizing a consultant agreement for executive-related services.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from August closed session, special, and regular Town Council meetings
Resolution to summarily vacate a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista
Resolution establishing preferential permit parking and time-limited parking
Consultant agreement authorization for executive services

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 2, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole reviewed the draft agenda for the September 15, 2026 meeting, including whether to add items or assign specific times to agenda topics. The September 8, 2026 meeting was cancelled, and the committee also reviewed the public record for late August and a study session on financing tools for economic development.
keyTopics: September 8, 2026 Council meeting cancelled
Review and possible additions to the September 15, 2026 draft agenda
Public Record review for August 20–27, 2026
Infrastructure Financing Tools for Economic Development study session

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — August 31, 2026
mountain-view.summary: Mountain View's Youth Advisory Committee held an orientation-style meeting covering how the committee operates, including a team-building activity and a review of open-meeting rules and procedures. Members also began brainstorming ideas for the committee's work plan for the upcoming fiscal year.
keyTopics: Team-building exercise for committee members
Overview of the Brown Act and Robert's Rules of Order
Discussion of the Youth Advisory Committee's role
Brainstorming for the FY 2026-27 work plan
Opportunity for public comment

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — August 25, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council held a special meeting that began with a closed session, followed by a public presentation later in the evening. The presentation portion covered an update on the CleanWater Program.
keyTopics: Closed session held before the public portion of the meeting
CleanWater Program update presentation

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 1, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met on September 1, 2026, and began with a report out from closed session. The agenda also included a note reminding individuals who lobby the City on legislative or administrative matters about registration and reporting requirements under the City's lobbying ordinance.
keyTopics: Report on items discussed in closed session
Reminder of lobbyist registration and reporting requirements under Cupertino's lobbying ordinance

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: This Santa Clara City Council meeting was held in a hybrid format, allowing a boardmember to join remotely from India while other members and the public participated in person or via Zoom. The agenda excerpt provided does not include specific policy items or discussion topics beyond meeting logistics and remote participation details.
keyTopics: Boardmember Chahal's remote participation from Panchkula, India
Hybrid meeting format with in-person and Zoom/phone access for the public

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 1, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council, sitting as the Successor Agency to the former Redevelopment Agency, considered routine financial and administrative business. This included confirming which city officials hold officer positions with the Successor Agency and authorizing the sale of refunding bonds to refinance existing redevelopment-related debt.
keyTopics: Confirming and designating city officials as officers of the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency
Authorizing the issuance and sale of 2026 Tax Allocation Refunding Bonds

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Economic Development Committee — August 26, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Economic Development Committee reviewed a staff presentation on the city's strategy for retaining, expanding, and attracting local businesses. The committee also received a monthly staff report covering economic development activity for August 2026.
keyTopics: Business Retention, Expansion, and Attraction (BRE/A) Strategy presentation
August 2026 Economic Development Activity Report
